UserPublicProfile.title: UserPublicProfile
UserPublicProfile.description: Non-sensitive user profile metadata keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document owner.

displayName.description: Display name shown in the scanner workspace.

provider.description: Authentication provider identifier (google, github, microsoft, apple, phone, password).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest profile update.

UserPrivateInfo.title: UserPrivateInfo
UserPrivateInfo.description: Isolated PII record storing the user's email and mobile phone number.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the owner.

email.description: User email address (optional for phone-only accounts).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the PII record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest update.

/users/{userId}/private/{docId}.description: Owner-only isolated PII collection for email and mobile number.
